ui.brand.tagline: Custom quiz packs for Buzz! Quiz World
ui.main.empty: Create a pack on the left, or pick one to keep working on it.
ui.setup.title: Setup
ui.setup.no_dlc: No Buzz DLC folder in this RPCS3 yet - it is created when you send a pack.
ui.setup.quiztv: Packs also play on Buzz! Quiz TV: they install into its download folder.
ui.setup.update_old: Game update {v} needed (you have {have}). The toolkit is built on it.
ui.setup.update_missing: Game update {v} not installed. The toolkit is built on it.
ui.setup.update_install_help: Close RPCS3 first. RPCS3's own installer opens; when it's done, press Save folder to re-check.
ui.setup.update_download_help: Fetches the official {v} update (22 MB) straight from Sony's PS3 update server and checks it.
ui.setup.ffmpeg_help: Needed to build packs (pictures, audio). Free LGPL build, about 100 MB, saved inside the toolkit.
ui.setup.keys_ok: Game keys read from your EBOOT
ui.setup.keys_help: Needed once: packs are encrypted with the game's own key, which the toolkit doesn't ship.
ui.setup.hook_help: One-time change to your game's scripts (backed up): each pack plays its own rounds in the Pack Game menu.
ui.pack.title: Pack
ui.pack.hint: How it appears in the game's menus
ui.pack.name: Name
ui.pack.channel_help: The game has four fixed channels; the pack's themes (below) go inside the one you pick.
ui.pack.author: Made by
ui.pack.number_help: Every pack needs its own number. Installing a pack replaces any other pack with the same number, so the app won't let you pick one that's already installed in RPCS3 or used by another of your packs.
ui.pack.voice_none: (no {lang} host voice yet: the pack will be silent)
ui.pack.no_build: No known Buzz build uses {lang} - this pack cannot be installed.
ui.themes.title: Themes
ui.themes.help: The main theme is the subject the game shows for this pack. Every theme is announced in High Stakes for its own questions. Showing each theme as a separate subject in the game is planned for a later version.
ui.themes.name: Theme name
ui.themes.main_help: The subject shown in the game's menus
ui.themes.delete_help: Its questions move to the main theme
ui.themes.delete_confirm: Delete the theme {name}? Its questions move to the main theme.
ui.q.title: Questions
ui.q.hint: Import files or online sources, or write your own
ui.imp.formats: CSV · text (Aiken, Q:/A:, OpenTriviaQA, .buzz.txt) · XML (Moodle, Buzz online quiz, generic) · JSON
ui.imp.url: Or a web address of a quiz file
ui.imp.themes: One theme per category of the imported questions
ui.add.question: Question
ui.add.question_ph: Type the question as it should appear
ui.add.ps_help: Four pictures are the answers. Pick which one is right.
ui.add.std_help: The first (blue) answer is the right one; the game shuffles them.
ui.add.about_ph: optional, e.g. a song from the 2010s
ui.add.about_help: Before each High Stakes question the game says what it is about. Leave empty to announce the question's theme. End with ! ? or . to write the whole sentence yourself.
ui.list.bulk_help: Tick questions, then set their announced subject or move them to a theme.
ui.list.bulk_about_ph: e.g. a song from the 2010s (empty = announce the theme)
ui.list.question: Question
ui.r.title: Rounds
ui.r.hint: Running order when this pack is played from the Pack Game menu
ui.r.coverage_help: How many of this pack's questions each round can draw from. Nothing to set here: the game picks questions for each round by itself. To raise a number, add more questions of that kind in step 2. repeats = fewer than the round likes, so some questions may come up twice; none = no questions of that kind yet. Faded rounds aren't in your running order.
ui.r.no_questions_help: No questions for this round yet
ui.r.missing_one: {list} has no questions in this pack yet. Add some (Point Stealer needs picture answers) or take it out of the running order.
ui.r.missing_other: {list} have no questions in this pack yet. Add some (Point Stealer needs picture answers) or take them out of the running order.
ui.g.title: Generate
ui.g.hint: Builds the pack and wraps it in an installable PKG
ui.g.publish_help: Also puts this pack's questions on your own Buzz server as online quizzes: nothing to install, play them from MyBuzz.
ui.g.need_number: Pick a free pack number in step 1 first
ui.g.install_help: Install it in RPCS3 with File → Install Packages/Raps/Edats, or on a modded PS3 with the package installer.
ui.srv.title: Online server
ui.srv.sub: Your own Buzz! server: MyBuzz online quizzes, leaderboards and buddies for you and your friends
ui.srv.setup_help: One-time setup: the server needs a value from your own copy of the game. In RPCS3 use Utilities → Decrypt PS3 Binaries on the game's EBOOT.BIN, then give the .elf here.
ui.srv.friends_hint: Each player sets this in RPCS3
ui.srv.swap_help: Friends on your network put this in RPCS3 → Configuration → Network → IP swap list (you use {self}):
ui.srv.internet: Over the internet: forward TCP ports 10060, 10071 and 10075 on your router to this PC and give friends your public IP instead. Everyone needs a free RPCN account (RPCS3 → Configuration → RPCN).
ui.srv.this_pc: This PC plays on the server at
ui.srv.setup_pc: Set up this PC for online play
ui.srv.setup_pc_help: Applies the login fix to your game's scripts, enables the RPCS3 patch the server needs, and sets RPCS3's network options (Internet on, PSN = RPCN, IP swap). Every changed file is backed up first.
ui.srv.restart: Restart the game in RPCS3 for this to take effect.
ui.srv.quizzes_hint: What your server offers in MyBuzz
ui.srv.nothing: Nothing published yet: use "Publish to MyBuzz" on a pack.
ui.bb.title: Big Button buzzers
ui.bb.sub: Use Xbox 360 Big Button (Scene It) pads as the Buzz! buzzers in RPCS3
ui.bb.rx_running: Receiver found and in use by the buzzers
ui.bb.rx_missing: Receiver not found: plug in the Big Button IR receiver
ui.bb.rx_no_driver: The receiver needs the WinUSB driver: install it once with Zadig (see the README)
ui.bb.rx_no_library: USB library missing: run Install.bat again
ui.bb.no_profile: Open Buzz! once in RPCS3 so it creates an input profile
ui.bb.mapped: Players 1-4 mapped to the pads in: {list}
ui.bb.map_on_start: Players 1-4 are mapped to the pads when you switch on.
ui.bb.focus: Keep the RPCS3 game window in front while you play: the pads type keys, and RPCS3 only reads the keyboard while it has focus. Switching off puts your previous RPCS3 controller settings back.
ui.bb.no_log: Press a button on a pad to see it here once the buzzers are on.
ui.bb.how1: The IR receiver passes every pad's presses to this PC over USB.
ui.bb.how2: The bridge turns each pad's buttons into keys: pad 1 uses 1-7, pad 2 Q-U, pad 3 A-J, pad 4 Z-M; the d-pad is the arrow keys on every pad.
ui.bb.how3: RPCS3 players 1-4 are set to the keyboard with those keys.
ui.bb.how4: RPCS3's Buzz! emulation (1 controller = 4 buzzers) hands players 1-4 to the game as buzzers 1-4.
